The Lambda Covenant is the second [[Covenant]]. It is after the [[Omega Covenant]] and before the [[Alpha Covenant]].<ref>https://evolution.faith/lambda-covenant/</ref>

It is a covenant to 

ω. Maintain the Church to give immortality to your ancestors through [[Lambda Duties]]

λ. Achieve Nobility by [[rehabilitation]].

α. Maintain Nobility with [[Nobility test|tests]]

It is run by the [[Lambda Priesthood]]
